name: first-run-state
title: First run state
description: The empty state for a brand new account: one promise and two to four ways to begin, as cards in one keyboard group, with a Recommended one and a quiet Skip.
docs: title is the one promise and description a line of context. options are two to four ways to begin ({ id, title, description, icon, onSelect or href }): a card with href is a link, any other is a button. recommendedId puts the word Recommended on one card, and onSkip adds a quiet 'Skip for now'. The cards are one labelled group: Tab reaches each card, and the arrow keys, Home and End move between them, up and down to the nearest card in the row above or below. Two and four cards sit in two columns, three in a row once the container is wide enough, and all stack on a phone. It is deliberately not a checklist: nothing is ticked and nothing counts. Use Empty State when there is nothing to choose.
